ruleDefinitions.name: Service DACL Abuse To Hide Services Via Sc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "sc.exe" utility adding a new service with special permission seen used by threat actors which makes the service hidden and unremovable.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "sc\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*sdset.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*DCLCWPDTSD.*")))
